blockers.detail: No eligible android device is visible.
Metro inspector endpoint is not reachable.
No RN/Expo debug target can be selected because Metro is unavailable.

nextAction.reason: Connect an eligible device or run on a self-hosted runner.

boundaries: This RN command orchestrates readiness and evidence packaging; it does not weaken proof-level labels.
A blocked RN result is not an app assertion failure.
Live RN success still requires device-backed verification and intake-backed promotion evidence.
